messages:
deploybot: kickstarting rolling backfill add_email_index_backfill v1. workers=6, window=10m per shard, target shards=8. deploy tag: backfill/2026-03-21-1
marco: holding a sec — infra-bot shows high replica_lag on users-repl-2 (90s). last time we saw indexes + lag caused long replication bursts and duplicate index builds
anya: +1 hold. don't want to stress replicas during business hours. can we narrow to single-shard canary? :hourglass:
infra-bot: METRIC: replica_lag > 60s on users-repl-2 for 4m. see: https://metrics.example/r/replica_lag/users-repl-2
ryan: pausing via rollout: `redwood rollout pause --deployment backfill/add_email_index_backfill`
deploybot: Rollout paused by ryan at 2026-03-21T13:19:05Z. awaiting ops guidance. :pause_button:
marco: let's do shard 3 canary only, workers=1, rate_cap=5rps, pin runner image to digest sha256:feedface
anya: please also pin the migration coordinator to release-2026-03-20 (there was a scheduler tweak yesterday) — `kubectl set image coordinator=coordinator:release-2026-03-20`
ryan: done. coordinator image set and canary scheduled. starting canary for shard 3
sre-oncall: FYI oncall: if canary fails, immediate rollback criteria: any duplicate index errors OR replica_lag > 120s OR >1% error rate for index builders in 2m window. otherwise we can abort gracefully
marco: running quick sanity SQL post-canary to confirm no partial index rows. SQL: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email_index_build_state = 'partial';`
anya: adding temporary feature-flag to block index consumer on legacy-sync: `ff:index_consumer_block=true` — escape hatch available to disable if needed
infra-bot: image digests: backfill-runner@sha256:feedface (deployed 2026-03-21T12:50), coordinator@sha256:beefcake (deployed 2026-03-20T23:05)
deploybot: Canary started for shard 3 at 2026-03-21T13:22:10Z. workers=1 rate_cap=5rps
marco: canary complete (5m). no replica_lag spike, no index errors in logs. proceeding slow roll: shards 3,5 then 1 then remainder in pairs
anya: updating release-notes: "add_email_index_backfill paused due to replica lag; canary shard 3 succeeded, slow-roll resumed with pinned images and feature-flag gate. No schema rollback."
ryan: filing follow-up to track scheduler tweak impact: ENG-6721. action items: add replication backpressure metric, add alert for index_builder_error > 0.5%
sre-oncall: noted. leaving thread pinned to eng-releases for audit. :pushpin:"
